text_en: Who would've thought that there was an entire labyrinth under Hafin?
Don't you just feel like a crocodile's going to appear at any moment? Ahaha... ha... cough, cough, it was a joke.
Anyway, let's not take up more of each other's time, yes? I'll leave you to be on your way, I'll be mapping out all of this. You can come and see my progress in my shop, if you'd like.
